Opus 5.5 made this galloping horse (entirely in code every pixel drawn procedurally).

One self-contained HTML file. Vanilla JS + Canvas 2D. No images or libraries.

128×96 pixels, articulated legs driven by inverse kinematics, 12-pose gallop...

Something is happening... https://t.co/dcjhiNMfJ3
